content.title: Dyne Therapeutics (DYN) Is Up 7.7% After DELIVER Trial Success and Accelerated Approval Plan – Has The Bull Case Changed?
content.summary: Dyne Therapeutics recently reported positive topline results from the Registrational Expansion Cohort of its Phase 1/2 DELIVER trial, showing that z-rostudirsen significantly increased dystrophin expression and improved multiple functional measures in people with Duchenne muscular dystrophy amenable to exon 51 skipping. On the back of these data, Dyne plans to seek U.S. Accelerated Approval in the second quarter of 2026, aiming to position z-rostudirsen as a potential new treatment option...
